descriptionChirho: Prey seized by a predator; torn flesh or the spoil of hunting; used of lions, wolves, and figuratively of violent plunder among people
Food or sustenance provided; an extended sense from prey to general nourishment, used of God providing food (Ps 111:5, Prov 31:15, Mal 3:10)
A fresh leaf or green foliage; Ezek 17:9 uses the construct plural for freshly plucked leaves — a distinct nominal sense possibly related to the root idea of tearing/plucking
